    FROM [Manga] AS [m]
    WHERE ([m].[DeleteDate] IS NULL) AND (([m].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL) OR ([m].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N''))
    ORDER BY [m].[UpdateDate] DESC
    OFFSET @__p_0 ROWS FETCH NEXT @__p_1 ROWS ONLY
) AS [t]
LEFT JOIN [Image] AS [i] ON [t].[Id] = [i].[MangaId]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [t1].[Id], [t1].[Title], [t1].[Index], [t1].[c], [t1].[MangaId]
    FROM (
        SELECT [c].[Id], [c].[Title], [c].[Index], 1 AS [c], [c].[MangaId], ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY [c].[MangaId] ORDER BY [c].[CreateDate] DESC) AS [row]
        FROM [Chapter] AS [c]
        WHERE [c].[DeleteDate] IS NULL
    ) AS [t1]
    WHERE [t1].[row] <= 1
) AS [t0] ON [t].[Id] = [t0].[MangaId]
ORDER BY [t].[UpdateDate] DESC
